<user_query>
Explore the repository read-only and report: 1) where project-local Cursor skills can live, 2) where always-applied rules are stored, 3) any existing agent workflow docs that should be linked for a new simulated QA review agent. Return concise bullet points with file paths and why each path is relevant.
</user_query>

Searching the repo for Cursor skills locations, rules, and agent workflow docs.

[REDACTED]

### 1) Project-local Cursor skills

- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\skills\<skill-name>\`** — Cursor’s intended **project** skill root: each skill is a folder with a required `SKILL.md` (and optional `reference.md`, `examples.md`, `scripts/`). Relevant because skills checked into the repo apply to everyone opening this workspace. *(Your workspace search did not show an existing `.cursor/skills/` tree yet; that path is still the right place to add one.)*
- **Contrast (not project-local):** **`~/.cursor/skills/`** — personal skills across projects; **`~/.cursor/skills-cursor/`** — reserved for Cursor-managed built-in skills (documented as “do not put custom skills here” in Cursor’s create-skill guidance).

### 2) Always-applied rules

- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** — Contains YAML frontmatter **`alwaysApply: true`**, so Cursor treats it as an **always-on workspace rule**; it binds substantive AXEL work to `AI_DOCS.md`, changelog updates, progress-feed format, and pipeline/doc updates.

### 3) Existing agent workflow docs to link for a simulated QA review agent

- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AI_DOCS.md`** — **Canonical** agent instructions: source hierarchy, combat/style/lore guardrails, **§9 Agent Workflow Requirements**, and **§10 consistency checklist** — primary “how agents should behave” doc.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AI_CHANGELOG.md`** — Expected place to **record conflicts, resolutions, and implemented pipeline changes** when QA findings imply canon or process updates.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** — Short **always-on** mirror of key governance (read `AI_DOCS.md` first, terminology, moon_princess reference-only, changelog + reusable pipeline documentation).
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md`** — **Concrete agent spec**: draft-first autonomy, **review-bundle outputs**, pipeline stages, data contracts, and pointers to validator/preview tools — good template for a **QA/review** agent’s scope and gates.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\SCENE_PATCH_INTERFACE.md`** — **Approval-gated** contract (`approved_drafts.json` → `scene_patch_instructions.json`) — defines what “allowed to proceed to implementation” means for scene tooling.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\SCENE_LAYOUT_RULES.md`** — **QA acceptance-style rules** for layouts (pathing, decay composition, placement roles, profiles, quarantine) — use as rubric when judging drafts.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_SCENES_BLUEPRINT.md`** and **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md`** — Listed as **canon sources** in `SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md` for scene intent; QA should reconcile drafts against these plus `AI_DOCS.md`.
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\tools\scene_builder\output\layout_validation.json`** and **`...\output\review_notes.md`** — Not “policy” docs, but **examples of machine/human review artifacts** the existing pipeline already emits (`AI_CHANGELOG.md` references them); useful so a simulated QA agent knows expected output shapes and where validation lands.

**Stuck state:** Not stuck — exploration complete (workspace tooling did not enumerate dot-folder globs reliably; paths above were verified by direct reads where cited).
